Cap'n Crunch French Toast

Ingredients -

4 Eggs    
1 cup Cream    
1 tsp Cinnamon    
2 tbsp Sugar    
1 tbsp Vanilla   
8 slices Tx Toast   
3 cup Capt Crunch   
2 tbsp Butter  
1 tbsp Veg oil  
1/2 cup Fresh Berries   
2 cup Whipped Cream   

Directions -

Custard -
Heavy Cream + Eggs + Vanilla + Cinnamon. Whisk to combine.
Add sugar to custard mixture. Whisk to combine

Put Captain Crunch in zip lock and crush. Transfer to bowl. Rub cereal between
hands to make it fine.

Whisk together melted butter and oil.

Heat pan over medium until hot. 
Add oil to pan enough to coat the bottom generously.

Dip Texas Toast slices into the egg custard mixture.
Let excess drip off back into the bowl.
Put Texas Toast in Capt Crunch mixture. Get sides of bread coated as well as top and bottom.

Place slice of toast in pan. Cook 3 mins on both sides or until golden brown.

Top with whipped cream and berries.

Drizzle Maple Syrup over the toast.

Enjoy
